body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Choose one visible enemy. Gain +1 Fortitude against its attacks until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Move 1 unit toward the chosen enemy.
One adjacent willing ally gains the same protection.

rider.title: Combo - Opener
rider.html: Gain 1 Combo if you have none. Your next Prowess hit on the chosen enemy before your next turn preserves 1 Combo from loss caused by your next Core Wound.
